pack.topic: Coimbatore Vacant Plot Rain & Drainage Site Inspection
pack.source_script_insight: Superficial surface inspection masks structural water issues; thoroughly assessing site slope, low-lying level, and drainage runoff pathways prevents catastrophic future waterlogging.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Inspecting vacant layout plots in fast-expanding Coimbatore localities during monsoon conditions to verify elevation, natural slope, and municipal storm-drain outlet access.
pack.core_takeaway: Always inspect land slope and water runoff paths during monsoon weather before finalizing a land purchase in Coimbatore.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Production Shot List for OliveTree SafeBuy (COIMBATORE ONLY). EXACTLY 10 SECONDS TOTAL, EXACTLY 7 SCENES, PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION REAL FOOTAGE ONLY. 90%+ real-looking visuals in native 9:16 portrait format. No 3D render, no toon animation, no corporate motion graphics explainer visual style.

Scene 1 (0.0s - 1.4s): Ground-level close-up shot outdoors in a vacant suburban residential layout in Coimbatore during overcast monsoon weather. Raindrops hitting wet soil near a fresh yellow-and-red painted stone boundary marker embedded in damp earth. Small rainwater puddle pooling nearby. Text overlay: 'மழைக்கால நிலப் பார்வை'. Audio: 'மழைக் காலத்தில் இடம் வாங்கும்போது...'

Scene 2 (1.4s - 2.8s): Eye-level handheld slow pan across a 4-cent vacant residential plot in Saravanampatti area, showing natural ground elevation variations, damp patches, and surrounding green coconut trees in background. Text overlay: 'மேற்பரப்பு மட்டும் போதாது!'. Audio: 'மேற்பரப்பு நிலத்தை மட்டும் பார்க்காதீங்க!'

Scene 3 (2.8s - 4.3s): Macro detail shot of yellow measuring tape extending down to measure natural ground dip depth next to concrete plot marker post. Realistic wet mud texture, real grit, realistic natural overcast daylight. Text overlay: 'சாய்வு & பள்ளம்'. Audio: 'நிலத்தின் சாய்வு மற்றும் பள்ளங்களைச் சரிபார்க்கவும்.'

Scene 4 (4.3s - 5.7s): Low-angle gimbal forward tracking shot moving alongside a 30-foot layout access road, showing a concrete storm water drainage channel with water flowing smoothly. Real red soil edges, asphalt texture, real roadside EB electric distribution pole in background. Text overlay: 'வடிகால் இணைப்பு'. Audio: 'மழைநீர் வடிகால் பாதை சரியாக இருக்கிறதா?'

Scene 5 (5.7s - 7.1s): Over-the-shoulder medium shot of hands holding a printed DTCP plot layout diagram against the background view of the vacant site, pointing at marked drainage corridor lines. Natural paper texture, realistic sunlight filtered through light clouds. Text overlay: 'வரைபட ஒப்பீடு'. Audio: 'வரைபடமும் நிலத்தின் வடிகால் பாதையும் ஒத்துப் போக வேண்டும்.'

Scene 6 (7.1s - 8.5s): High-angle wide site perspective shot dropping slowly over a clean, well-drained plotted land parcel in Coimbatore, showing clean access roads, clear boundary stones, and nearby residential houses in distance. Text overlay: 'நீர் தேங்கல் பரிசோதனை'. Audio: 'வாங்கும் முன்பே நீர் தேங்கும் அபாயத்தைக் கண்டறியுங்கள்.'

Scene 7 (8.5s - 10.0s): Medium shot outdoors on real site in overcast daylight, clip board with property verification checklist being checked off with blue pen. Background shows clear plot layout and distant Western Ghats hills backdrop. Text overlay overlaying real footage: 'OliveTree SafeBuy'. Audio: 'பாதுகாப்பான நிலத் தேர்வுக்கு OliveTree SafeBuy!'

Visual Continuity Rules: Consistent overcast monsoon daylight setting across all shots, authentic Coimbatore suburban scenery (coconut palm fringes, red soil, asphalt layout roads), hyper-realistic skin tones, real document paper textures. Overlays are minimalistic white transparent Tamil text boxes.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: 3D render, cartoon, 2D animation, corporate motion graphic, fake floating text cards, glossy futuristic cityscape, fake CGI house models, unrealistic lighting, landscape aspect ratio, black bars, blurred sidebars, non-Tamil Nadu locations, exaggerated architectural models.
pack.title_english: Inspect Coimbatore Land Slope & Drainage Before Buying
pack.caption_english:
Buying a vacant plot during monsoon in Coimbatore? Don't just judge the ground when it looks dry in summer. Water stagnation and improper layout slope can lead to severe flooding, foundation dampness, and costly retaining wall expenses later.

Always inspect the plot elevation, verify roadside storm drain connections, and cross-check natural drainage channels with layout maps during site visits.

Ensure complete peace of mind with verified land inspections in Coimbatore through OliveTree SafeBuy.
